svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or sand.gallery. Q: tell me more about LadderStar LadderStar (ladderstar.com) is a live AI interview platform. Candidates audition in a real-time, voice-to-voice room running on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. A full product: job board, public talent and employer profiles, real-time messaging, an admin console and blog publishing Token-based employer screenings with consent-gated recording Firebase auth with rules-unit-tested Firestore security rules, plus Stripe billing Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, the Gemini Live API, Stripe and Vercel. Q: hold on, airship mods? Two published mods for Create: Aeronautics, on CurseForge and Modrinth: procedural delivery contracts with physics-compiled cargo, and a preflight tool that simu…
